summary: Leonardo DRS filed an 8-K announcing a definitive agreement to acquire Raft LLC, a McLean-based mission software and AI company, in an all-cash deal valued at $450 million. The acquisition enhances DRS's multi-domain AI, data fusion, and open-architecture software capabilities for defense customers. No premium, board recommendation, or advisors are specified. The transaction is expected to close pending regulatory approvals, typical for defense tech. Watch for closing conditions, antitrust review, and integration execution as risk-arb considerations.
